purpose: Bind the user's current instruction to a bounded I-49 read-only review of the already evidenced checkpoint pair and exactly the 500 names in the existing comparison artifact. This does not rewrite or backdate the prior run authorization.

task.title: Сравнить тензоры двух checkpoints на CPU
task.criterion: Проверить разрешённые параметры выборочно, без загрузки полной модели

owner_instruction.basis: Direct user instruction in the current conversation, interpreted as authorization to finish I-49 by a bounded read-only CPU comparison of this exact checkpoint pair.
owner_instruction.timestamp_note: Timestamp records when this instruction was bound into this evidence artifact; it is not inferred as a historical authorization timestamp for the earlier comparison run.
owner_instruction.permitted_scope: Use only the two Drive folders and the exact existing 500 common tensor names identified by the bound all500 artifact.

pair_binding.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', ensure_ascii=true; object has before and after keys, each containing drive_folder_id, assembled_bytes, assembled_sha256.
pair_binding.provenance_basis: The existing I-49 receipt records local assembly sizes and aggregate SHA-256 matching each JOIN file and all eight part hashes matching SHA256SUMS. The all500 report is bound to the same two aggregate SHA-256 values. The current Drive manifest recheck and limits are documented in source_evidence_erratum_20261119_i49.json.

tensor_name_set.selection_rule: Exactly the 500 unique name strings already present in comparison.tensors; no name was added or inferred.
tensor_name_set.name_set_sha256_canonicalization: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted unique UTF-8 names joined by LF, with one trailing LF.

comparator_binding.method: Safetensors header validation and bounded 1 MiB payload hashing for explicitly supplied names; no tensor arrays or base model loaded.

limitations: The 500 names were not a pre-existing allowlist; this record binds only the user's current instruction to the exact existing set and does not assert a historical owner event.
The byte-hash comparison establishes payload-byte changes, not elementwise numeric delta magnitudes, training provenance, or model quality.
This record does not claim training readiness or any model execution.
